# Field

```ts
import { Field } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A read-only label and value — one row of facts in a detail view, side sheet or card ("Functional area: IT Infrastructure"). It displays data; it is not a form field. To collect input, use TextInput, Dropdown and the other inputs.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The name of the value ("Functional area", "Serial number"). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The value. Plain text, or any node (a Badge, a Rating, an Avatar). |
| `layout` | `'inline' \| 'stacked'` | `'inline'` | inline puts the label in a 160px column beside the value (detail views, drawers); stacked puts the label above the value (narrow cards). |
| `href` | `string` | — | Makes the value a link to this destination (Figma type=link), rendered with the hello pc Link at body size. |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional provenance line under the value ("Updated Nov 3 · By Alex Kim"). |
| `info` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Explains the label in a tooltip behind a 16px info icon (Figma showInfo). The icon is focusable, so keyboard and screen-reader users get the text too. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'children'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<Field label="Functional area">IT Infrastructure, Cloud, AI</Field>
<Field label="Owner" layout="stacked">Alex Kim</Field>
<Field label="Ticket" href="/tickets/4821">INC-4821</Field>
<Field label="Warranty" meta="Updated Nov 3 · By Alex Kim">Premier, through 2028</Field>
<Field label="Tier" info="Set by your account manager">Gold</Field>
<FieldGroup><Field label="Model">ThinkPad X1</Field><Field label="Serial">PF3K21</Field></FieldGroup>
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-text-icon-secondary`, `--type-size-body`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--color-text-icon-link`, `--color-text-icon-placeholder`, `--type-size-caption`, `--space-300`, `--space-050`, `--space-025`, `--space-200`

## Accessibility

- Label/value pairs are a description list, so screen readers announce them as terms and definitions, and the relationship survives without the visual layout.
- info renders a real button with an accessible name ("About Functional area"), so the tooltip text is reachable from the keyboard.
- Link values are ordinary links named by their text.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use Field to show facts in detail views | Use it to collect input — that's a form control |
| Group related fields in a FieldGroup | Build key–value rows from loose text |
| Keep labels short nouns | Put sentences in the label column |
| Pick one layout per group | Mix inline and stacked in the same list |
